title: Karbela na bhulenge
body:
Karbela na bhulenge
Karbela na bhulenge
<<DIVIDER>>
(Bhul jayenge har gham) x2
<<MINI>>
Gham tera na bhulenge
(Karbela na bhulenge) x2
(Karbela na bhulenge) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. (Bhul jayenge har gham) x3
<<MINI>>
Gham tera na bhulenge
(Karbela na bhulenge) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kaise bhul jaye maktale hussain ko, (kaise bhul jaye fatema ke bain ko) x2
(Ba khuda na bhulenge) x3
<<MINI>>
Gham tera na bhulenge
(Karbela na bhulenge) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Wo sitam wo zulm wo jaffa ke silsilay, (Al kama ke samene khayam jal gaye) x2
(Nainawa na bhulenge) x3
<<MINI>>
Gham tera na bhulenge
(Karbela na bhulenge) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jis jaga hussain ka jawaa huwa shahid, (Jis jaga huwa tha ek be zubaan shahid) x2
(Wo jaga na bhulenge) x3
<<MINI>>
Gham tera na bhulenge
(Karbela na bhulenge) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Wo lahu bhara alam wo mashk khun bhari, (Intizar aab me sakina margayi) x2
<<MINI>>
(Majera na bhulenge) x3
Gham tera na bhulenge
(Karbela na bhulenge) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Khun rowe jiske gham me umre bhar imam, (laygayi thi lut ke rida jo foje shaam) x2
(Wo ridaa na bhulenge) x3
<<MINI>>
Gham tera na bhulenge
(Karbela na bhulenge) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
7. As salaam karbela ke khak as salaam, (As salaam dafn jisme paak as salaam) x2
(ye sadaa na bhulenge) x3
<<MINI>>
Gham tera na bhulenge
(Karbela na bhulenge) x4
